calls.prompt:
You are an EXTRACTION agent in a multi-agent pipeline. Do not use any tools. Do not read files or search. Respond directly.

From the document below, extract the key structured facts only. Be factual and concise - at most 120 words. Output just the facts, no preamble.

Document:
"Support case SUP-9931, priority high. Customer Maria (premium plan, 3-year tenure) reports she was charged 79 dollars twice for her annual renewal on April 2 - once at 09:14 and again at 09:16. She opened a ticket the same day; it sat unassigned for 5 days because of a misrouted queue tag. The duplicate charge happened because the billing retry logic re-submitted the payment after a gateway timeout, even though the first charge had already succeeded; the renewal endpoint has no idempotency key. Maria has contacted support twice and left a 1-star review citing 'being ignored for a week.' Finance confirmed both charges cleared. The refund of the duplicate 79 dollars has not yet been issued. The team notes 14 similar duplicate-charge tickets in the last month, all on renewals after gateway timeouts."
calls.output:
SUP-9931, priority high.

Customer: Maria, premium plan, 3-year tenure.

Issue: Charged $79 twice for annual renewal on April 2 (09:14 and 09:16).

Root cause: Billing retry logic re-submitted payment after a gateway timeout when the first charge had already succeeded; renewal endpoint has no idempotency key.

Ticket: Opened same day; sat unassigned 5 days due to misrouted queue tag.

Customer actions: Contacted support twice; left a 1-star review citing being ignored for a week.

Status: Finance confirmed both charges cleared; refund of duplicate $79 not yet issued.

Scope: 14 similar duplicate-charge tickets in the last month, all on renewals after gateway timeouts.
